title: One roster entry: one man as one source printed him, joined to the unit he belongs to at Gettysburg

id.description: stable: <unit_id>-<company or FS>-<zero padded sequence in source order>; never reused when rows are removed (a removed row becomes a tombstone in the ledger)

unit_id.description: matches regiment_id or battery_id in baseline/dist/data/oob (for example U-20ME, C-26NC)

company.description: A-K, FS (field and staff), BAND, REC (recruits not on company rolls), or battery section

attached_to_unit_id.description: set when documented present with another unit (for example detached in Battery B, 4th U.S. Artillery)

rank_at_battle.description: only when a source gives it; rank-from dates later than 3 July 1863 are not used

name_as_printed.description: exactly as in the source after OCR; never silently corrected

surname_key.description: lower case, letters only, used for search shards

variants.description: other spellings found in other sources or on other pages

probability.description: present-probable only: the documented estimate that he was present, with the model named in basis; null for the other labels

items.description: rule codes, for example CAS-REMARK (casualty remark names Gettysburg), PART-LIST (named on a participants list), MUSTER-JUN63-PRESENT, OFFICER-HISTORY, SEP-BEFORE, ENL-AFTER, DRAFTED-1864, ONROLL-NO-STATUS, OCR-DATE-LOST

source_id.description: key into sources.json (the ledger), for example WI-ROSTER-1886-v1

locator.description: page or entry, for example p.513

evidence_label.description: the site vocabulary: present-documented and absent-documented = Documented; present-probable = Modelled; unknown = Unknown; a row on a contested unit reconciliation = Contested
